On 7 May 2021, employees of a mining company gathered outside the Katilungu House in Kitwe (Kitwe, Copperbelt) in a demonstration against a bank, which, they stated, treat the terms of the loans they acquired unfairly.
On 27 April 2021, miners and contractors of a copper mine company took to the streets in Chingola (Chingola, Copperbelt) in a demonstration against the company's corruption and poor management.

On 16 April 2021, some miners gathered in the city of Chingola (Chingola, Copperbelt) in a demonstration for better working conditions. The group also held a demonstration on 13 April 2021 (coded separately).

On 13 April 2021, over 2,000 miners blocked the streets in the city of Chingola (Chingola, Copperbelt) in a demonstration for better working conditions. The police arrested 20 people. The Mine Contractors and Allied Workers Union believe that the demonstration was politically sponsored. The group also held a demonstration on 16 April 2021 (coded separately).

ASSOC_ACTOR_1: UPND: United Party for National Development
NOTES: On 12 March 2021, a group wearing UPND regalia pelted stones at police officers in Kitwe (Kitwe, Copperbelt) after they asked the group to disperse. 25 people were arrested. No demonstration activity was reported at the time.

On 2 March 2021, hundreds of miners staged demonstrations in the Chingola district (Copperbelt) to demand the exit of an international mining company from the activities of a national mining company in the area. The group also demonstrated against the lack of economic opportunities and demanded the payment of late wages.

On 1 March 2021, health workers were attacked with stones and other objects by a mob in Zambezi (Zambezi, North-West) as they were trying to deliver the body of a teacher suspected of having died from coronavirus for burial. The group also damaged the school the man had worked at.

Around 17 February 2021 (as reported), a man was killed by a mob of 7 individuals in the Naponda Village, near Kasama (Kasama, Northern), over witchcraft accusations and being involved in the death of his grandson.
On 16 February 2021, a woman was beaten to death by a mob of 3 people in the Mupitashi area in Chingola (Chingola, Copperbelt) over witchcraft accusations. 1 suspect was arrested.

ASSOC_ACTOR_2: PF: Patriotic Front; Government of Zambia (2011-2021)
NOTES: Around 25 November 2020 (as reported), a group assaulted the PF Member of Parliament of the Bahati constituency (Luapula) while he visiting the region. According to reports, the group was dissatisfied with his government.

Around 2 November 2020 (as reported), a group destroyed two houses in the Chipulukusu area in Ndola (Ndola, Copperbelt) after a rumor that a local woman was behind the death of her son. 20 people were arrested.

ASSOC_ACTOR_1: UPND: United Party for National Development
NOTES: On 14 October 2020, UNDP members attacked residents of the Mununga area, Mpika District (Muchinga) after they refused to shout their party slogan. The group used machetes; an unidentified number of people were injured, one severely. The event happened as an UNDP entourage were reaching Lusaka after a campaign in the northern province. UNDP members also detained 2 police officers and beat them along with civilians in the village of Lavushimanda (Muchinga).

Around 10 October 2020 (as reported), workers from a industrial engineering company held a demonstration inside the company in Mkushi (Mkushi, Central) to demand the payment of wages.

On 9 October 2020, more than 700 former employees of a mining company took to the streets in Chililabombwe (Chililabombwe, Copperbelt) and handed a petition to the Chililabombwe District Commissioner demanding the payment of their pension contributions.

The man had been accused of stealing from the business. Police attempted to disperse the crowd.

The group tried to forcibly enter the company's building to demand their delayed salaries. The group threw stones at officers who were trying to disperse them. No reports on injuries.

On 26 September 2020, a man was beaten by police officers inside his house in Kasanda (Kabompo, North-Western). He was taken to a police station and died from his injuries. The motivation for the attack and arrest are unknown.
